title: fire — getting your data in, narrated

scenes.title: Every account. However it lives.
scenes.say: Getting your money into fire takes minutes, and none of it leaves your control.

scenes.title: Drop in a CSV.
scenes.say: Drop in a Fidelity positions export, or a Chase or Capital One statement. It's parsed locally, and spending is categorized for you.

scenes.title: Or link it.
scenes.say: Or link accounts through Plaid, and holdings and transactions sync and categorize themselves.

scenes.title: Crypto: paste an ENS name.
scenes.say: For crypto, paste an ENS name or a wallet address. fire totals coins and tokens across seven chains, with no API keys. CoinTracker works too.

scenes.title: Gold at today's spot.
bullets: Gold and silver by the ounce
scenes.say: Gold and silver are entered by the ounce and valued at live spot. Vehicles track value, loan balance and depreciation.

scenes.title: Cash, CDs and property.
scenes.say: Savings earn their APY, CDs count down to maturity, and real estate tracks equity against the mortgage.

scenes.title: One number. Always current.
scenes.say: Then prices update while you watch, so your net worth is always current.

scenes.title: Your money. Your machine.
scenes.say: fire. Try it live at lifefire dot netlify dot app.
